items.item_text: CA RN and CA NP License- required
State of California NP, State of CA NP Furnishing with Schedule II, National Certification (i.e. ANCC)-required
BLS and ACLS certification from AHA or ARC
1 year neurology experience as a NP- required
Previous Stroke Team experience - strongly preferred

The Stroke Nurse Practitioner provides comprehensive inpatient stroke and neurologic care at UCLA Santa Monica Hospital as part of a 24/7 stroke program supporting emergency, inpatient, and critical care services. The APP functions as an integral member of the multidisciplinary stroke team and participates in rapid evaluation and management of patients presenting with acute stroke and neurologic emergencies.

This role includes participation in around the clock stroke coverage, including days, nights, weekends, and holidays. The Stroke APP collaborates closely with neurology attendings, emergency medicine physicians, nursing, pharmacy, rehabilitation services, radiology, and hospital operations to support timely, evidence based stroke care and optimize patient outcomes.
MSN or DNP in NP Specialty (AG-AC NP/Adult - Gero Acute Care NP)
Enrollment in PECOS, Enrollment in CURES
Document patient care in a concise and comprehensive manner- required
Ability to utilize excel, word and other software program-required
Ability to establish and maintain cooperative and collaborative working relationships with administrative, clinical and academic personnel-required
Skill in working independently and following through with minimum direction-required
Demonstrate writing skills to compose logical, detailed and grammatically correct correspondence-required
